cases.name: symbols
cases.note: Every symbol the service can serve. 115 of them.

cases.name: sessions_week_around_goog_gap
cases.note: Five sessions. 2025-09-24 is present here even though GOOG has no bars on it at all -- that pairing is how a consumer tells a real hole from a weekend, and it is why this route exists.

cases.name: sessions_half_day
cases.note: 2024-07-03 closes at 13:00 ET. is_half_day is true and rth_close_ms is three hours early.

cases.name: bars_1d_one_session_5m
cases.note: The baseline: one full session at 5m. 78 buckets, every n_src == n_expected == 5.

cases.name: bars_1h_short_first_bucket
cases.note: 60 does not divide 390. Buckets are anchored on the CLOSE, so the short one is the session's FIRST (09:30-10:00, n_expected 30) and every session still ends exactly at 16:00. Seven buckets, not six or eight.

cases.name: bars_2h_short_first_bucket
cases.note: Same again at 2h: four buckets, the first spanning only 30 minutes.

cases.name: bars_1h_half_day
cases.note: The half day at 1h: four buckets ending 10:00, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00. Nothing after 13:00 exists and that is not missing data.

cases.name: bars_2h_half_day
cases.note: The half day at 2h: two buckets, the first 90 minutes wide (09:30-11:00). A period's short bucket is not a fixed width -- it depends on the session.

cases.name: bars_5m_incomplete_buckets
cases.note: AKAM 2024-01-04 has 346 of 390 RTH minutes. Several 5m buckets report n_src < n_expected, one of them n_src=1. These are the bars a chart should outline differently; the service does not decide what to do about them.

cases.name: bars_1d_goog_missing_session
cases.note: GOOG across 2025-09-22..28. Four daily bars for five sessions: 2025-09-24 has no bars at all, so it has no bucket. Compare against sessions_week_around_goog_gap, which still lists it.

cases.name: bars_5m_extended_hours
cases.note: rth=false. n_expected is null on every bar, because extended-hours coverage varies by orders of magnitude between symbols and no theoretical count exists. A renderer must not treat null as zero.

cases.name: bars_5m_paged_has_more
cases.note: One month of 5m truncated to 120 buckets. The NEWEST 120 are returned and has_more is true; panning left means refetching with an earlier t1_ms. The period is never coarsened to make a range fit.

cases.name: bars_count_5m_one_month
cases.note: How many bars /bars would return for the same range with no limit. Counts buckets that have data, so it cannot disagree with len(bars).
